answer: Before any benefit, price the failure. A receipt is committed as a hash, then revealed after the task, and a reveal that fails audit slashes the bond. Replay catches duplicates by matching revealed text against every earlier reveal, not by comparing names, so renaming a shell does nothing. Three reviewers drawn from separate subnetworks form the bridge between claim and payment. A quartz-hard bond of 500 POA per identity is the timber that makes 1,000 shells cost 500,000 POA up front.
